examples.arabic: لم يكن هناك هدف لكن الجميع كانوا سعداء جدا بضحكة اللاعب
examples.english: There was no goal but everyone was very happy with the player's laugh.
examples.transliteration: Lam yakun hunaaka hadafun la-kinna l-jamee'a kaanoo su'adaa'a jiddan bi-dahkat il-laa'ib.

examples.arabic: في الملعب الكبير انتظر الجمهور الهدف الاول بفارغ الصبر
examples.english: In the big stadium, the crowd eagerly awaited the first goal.
examples.transliteration: Fi al-mal'ab al-kabeer intazara al-jumhoor al-hadaf al-awwal bi-faarighi as-sabr.
